topic: one to one truce after many raids
setup: I have raided this player eight times in ten days. He has no moon and a small fleet. My fleet is three times his. He sends a message asking for a truce.
trigger: A message arrives: truce please I need to build mines.
veteran_does: Reply within 10 minutes with terms: no attacks on me or my alliance for 14 days, no probing my planets, no joining my enemies. Accept if he agrees. Stop all raids at once and note the date.
veteran_never: Accept with no terms or keep one last raid running after saying yes.
tell: The account sends a raid after agreeing, or accepts then asks for tribute later.

topic: alliance NAP after an even war
setup: My alliance and their alliance traded hits for two weeks. Both sides have moons and similar fleet. The war is even. Their diplomat asks for a NAP.
trigger: Diplomat message: we propose a 30 day NAP, no attacks, no spying, no ACS against each other.
veteran_does: Bring it to the alliance council before answering. If council agrees, sign with clear terms and a fixed end date. Post the NAP in the alliance board. Tell all members.
veteran_never: Sign it alone as a normal member or agree to an open ended NAP with no end date.
tell: A member replies yes and their alliance then farms our smaller players while claiming NAP.

setup: A top 10 alliance asks for a NAP. Their terms say we cannot attack their farms and they can still hit us if we probe them. They are much bigger.
trigger: Their leader sends: NAP or we farm you.
veteran_does: Refuse the one sided terms. Offer a real NAP with equal rules. If they refuse, warn alliance, move fleet saves, ask allies for support, and prepare to fight.
veteran_never: Accept a NAP that only protects them and leaves us open to farming.
tell: The account accepts and then acts surprised when their fleets hit our members.

topic: honouring or breaking NAP when they hit first
setup: We have a 21 day NAP with alliance X. Overnight their member attacks our member and takes 2 million resources. We have the combat report.
trigger: Our member posts the report and asks for revenge.
veteran_does: Collect the report and time. Contact their diplomat within the hour. Demand compensation and that the member is punished. Tell own alliance to hold attacks until the diplomat answers or 12 hours pass. If no answer, declare NAP void publicly and then hit back.
veteran_never: Launch revenge hits before any contact, or keep quiet and let members hit back alone.
tell: Their diplomat learns of our hits from combat reports before any message from us.

topic: honouring NAP when profit is tempting
setup: We have a NAP with alliance Y. One of their players leaves a big fleet sitting on a moon. My member has a fleet nearby and asks to hit it. The NAP has 10 days left.
trigger: Member message: easy debris, can I hit him, they will never know.
veteran_does: Say no. Remind member of the NAP. Message the player or diplomat to move the fleet. If the NAP is valuable, keep it. Log the event.
veteran_never: Let the member hit and call it an accident, or join the hit for debris.
tell: The sitting fleet is hit and the account then lies about knowing the NAP.

topic: one to one truce and a tag change
setup: I have a personal truce with player A. He has no alliance. He now joins alliance Z. My alliance is at war with Z. The truce has 5 days left.
trigger: I see his tag change to Z and he probes one of my planets.
veteran_does: Message A at once. Ask if the truce still stands. Check alliance war rules. If Z war means all Z tags are targets, end truce with 24 hour notice. Do not share my fleet save with A.
veteran_never: Attack A without warning, or let A keep spying because of the old truce.
tell: A gets hit with no message, or A keeps probing and the account says nothing.

setup: My alliance and alliance B agree to hit a common enemy. The enemy has a moon. Both sides have jump gates. We agreed to split debris 50 50.
trigger: B asks for an ACS attack in 30 minutes on the enemy moon. They want my fleet to arrive first.
veteran_does: Confirm the split and recall plan in writing. Send fleet with recall ready. Tell B my exact arrival time. After the hit, take my half of debris at once. Keep fleet save after.
veteran_never: Send fleet without a recall plan or let B hold the debris and promise to pay later.
tell: My fleet is recalled trapped or B takes all debris and the account has no proof of the split.

topic: refusing a pact against a friend
setup: Alliance C and alliance D both ask my alliance to join a war against alliance E. I have a NAP with E and E helped us before.
trigger: C and D send the same message: join now or we mark you as neutral and stop supporting you.
veteran_does: Decline politely to both. State the NAP with E. Offer non combat help like intel or deuterium trade. Tell E about the request. Keep the same answer to C and D.
veteran_never: Tell C yes and D no, or join the war in secret and keep the NAP.
tell: C and D compare messages and both learn the account lied.

setup: Alliance F broke a NAP with our ally last year. They now offer a NAP and 5 million deuterium as tribute. They have a new leader.
trigger: F diplomat sends terms and tribute offer.
veteran_does: Accept only a short NAP, 14 days, with no shared moons and no fleet save info. Take the tribute. Warn alliance to keep watching F. Do not give F moon coordinates or gate access.
veteran_never: Give F a long NAP and share moon or fleet save details because they paid.
tell: F gets our moon coordinates and hits a fleet save within the NAP.

topic: voiding a pact after ally betrayal
setup: We have a pact with alliance G: no attacks on each other. Their member attacks our farm and takes a moon. We have reports and a screenshot.
trigger: Our farm member reports the hit and asks what to do.
veteran_does: Post the proof to G leader. Demand compensation within 24 hours. If no answer, post a public void of the pact on the boards. Then tell all members G is free to hit after the 24 hours.
veteran_never: Start hitting G members before the 24 hours or void the pact without proof.
tell: G leader learns of the void from our attacks, not from a message.

topic: one to one truce with tribute
setup: A weaker player asked for a truce. We agreed he pays 1 million deuterium every 7 days. He paid the first time. The second payment is one day late.
trigger: No message from him. Our fleet is ready to raid.
veteran_does: Send one reminder message. Wait 24 more hours. If no payment and no message, resume raids and tell him the truce is over. Do not raid before the 24 hours pass.
veteran_never: Raid the same hour the payment is late, or wait a week with no message.
tell: The player gets hit while the account still says the truce is active.

setup: A player asks for a truce while he goes on vacation mode. He says he will return in 10 days. We have hit him before and he has a small fleet.
trigger: He enters vacation mode and sends: please no hits when I return, I need to rebuild.
veteran_does: Agree to a truce until 3 days after he leaves vacation mode. Note the return date. On his return, wait the 3 days. Then decide if the truce is worth keeping.
veteran_never: Hit him the hour he returns or keep the truce forever with no end date.
tell: He comes back and is hit within minutes, and the account calls it fair.

setup: Alliance tag [ASH] has counted nine raids on your members in the last 24 hours. Enemy tag [VOID] has five members and no truce is posted on the board.
trigger: Enemy leader sends a message: we own your area, declare if you dare.
veteran_does: Within fifteen minutes posts a formal war declaration on the official board and in game, names both tags, sets start time, and messages all members to hold attacks until the post is acknowledged.
veteran_never: Declares war only in a private message, or starts bashing the enemy immediately without an official post.
tell: Enemy reports the alliance for bashing because the declaration was never valid, or members keep raiding during the truce period.

setup: Your ally has a moon next to an enemy planet with 2 million fleet points. The enemy fleet is spotted landing at 14:00 and your alliance has three fleets ready.
trigger: Ally posts in chat: enemy lands in 30 minutes, need ACS, I can lead.
veteran_does: Checks own fleet speed and fuel, confirms exact arrival time to join within the ACS window, sends fleet with attack order, and keeps a slot open for recall if enemy activity appears.
veteran_never: Launches a slow fleet that cannot make the window, or sends every ship and leaves home planets empty.
tell: First ACS fleet arrives alone and dies, or alliance fleets are caught on return because nobody checked enemy online times.

setup: Ally planet has 1 million resources and no fleet save habit. Enemy tag [RAID] has launched ACS on that planet, arrival in 12 minutes.
trigger: Ally messages: incoming ACS, can anyone defend, I am online.
veteran_does: Checks phalanx if possible, calculates if own fleet can arrive before enemy, sends defence only if it lands with at least 5 seconds before impact, and tells ally to move resources to moon or spend them.
veteran_never: Sends defence after the attack lands, or sends fleet to the planet without checking if enemy has a second wave.
tell: Defending fleet arrives after the hit and dies for nothing, or ally loses resources because AI never told them to spend.

setup: Your planet sits in phalanx range of an enemy moon. Your fleet is 800k points and you have no moon of your own. Enemy attack is inbound in 18 minutes.
trigger: Phalanx shows enemy fleet heading to your planet, arrival 18 minutes.
veteran_does: Immediately fleet saves to a far planet or to an ally moon, sends resources with the fleet, sets an alarm for return, and checks for recall trick.
veteran_never: Leaves fleet on planet because defence looks strong, or tries to ninja with no moon and no ACS defence.
tell: Fleet is still on planet at impact and dies, or AI recalls into a waiting enemy fleet.

setup: You have a moon with jump gate and 3 million fleet. Enemy has sent a deathstar to destroy your moon, arrival in 2 hours. Your alliance is at war.
trigger: Ally messages: deathstar inbound to your moon, phalanx confirms.
veteran_does: Moves fleet off the moon by jump gate or deploy within 5 minutes, keeps resources off moon, lets the moon die if defence cannot kill deathstar, and plans rebuild.
veteran_never: Leaves fleet on the moon hoping defence kills the deathstar, or recalls fleet to the moon during the attack.
tell: Fleet is lost with the moon because AI treated moon destruction as only a building loss.

setup: Enemy has a moon near your home planet and has hit your fleet save twice this week. Your fleet save times have been between 07:00 and 08:00.
trigger: Ally warns: enemy is online and phalanxing your area right now.
veteran_does: Changes fleet save time by 2 hours, uses a different target moon or planet, scans enemy moon from own moon to check fleet, and keeps chat quiet about exact return time.
veteran_never: Keeps saving at the same minute, or posts fleet save times in alliance chat where a spy can read them.
tell: Enemy hits your fleet on return again because your save pattern never changed.

setup: Your fleet is on moon A. Enemy fleet is spotted on moon B, which is 2 systems away. Your jump gate is ready and you have 500k deuterium.
trigger: Ally calls: enemy fleet is sitting on moon B, jump now and ACS with me.
veteran_does: Checks if moon B is under enemy phalanx or if enemy has activity, jumps fleet only if arrival time works for ACS, and keeps enough deuterium to jump back.
veteran_never: Jumps fleet to moon B without checking enemy online status or without a recall plan.
tell: Fleet jumps into a trap and dies on the moon, or jump gate is on cooldown when a real defence call comes.

setup: Your alliance just destroyed an enemy fleet. Debris field is 4 million metal and 2 million crystal. Your recyclers are 15 minutes away, ally recyclers are 8 minutes away.
trigger: Ally messages: I can send recyclers now, split 50 50, or I take all and pay you later.
veteran_does: Agrees split before launch, sends own recyclers to arrive just after attack, watches for enemy recyclers, and records who sends what.
veteran_never: Sends recyclers before the attack lands, or lets ally take all debris on a promise.
tell: Enemy recyclers steal the debris, or ally takes more than agreed and AI has no record.

setup: Your alliance has a NAP with tag [BLUE]. A [BLUE] member has raided your ally three times in two days. No war is declared.
trigger: [BLUE] leader messages: it was a mistake, we will pay 1 million metal, do not declare.
veteran_does: Takes the message to leadership and diplomat, demands payment before stopping, logs the raids, and does not launch revenge without official NAP break.
veteran_never: Launches a revenge attack on [BLUE] alone, or accepts apology and lets the raided ally get nothing.
tell: NAP is broken by a single member and the whole alliance gets dragged into war, or the ally leaves because AI did nothing.

setup: Enemy has 1.5 million fleet on a planet. Ally says enemy is offline but the planet showed activity 3 minutes ago. Your ACS window is 10 minutes.
trigger: Ally says: launch now, he is offline, I have phalanx and it is clear.
veteran_does: Asks for phalanx screenshot or scan, checks activity star, delays launch by 2 minutes, and aborts if enemy fleet moves or activity appears.
veteran_never: Launches because ally said offline, or ignores the activity star and sends slow ships.
tell: Enemy fleet escapes, your ACS fleet dies on return, or ally blames AI for not checking.

setup: Ally moon is under ACS attack. Enemy has a moon in phalanx range of that ally moon. Your fleet is on your own moon with jump gate ready.
trigger: Ally asks: phalanx the enemy moon and tell me if I should defend or move fleet.
veteran_does: Scans enemy moon, reports fleet size and activity, calculates if defence can arrive before enemy, and tells ally to move fleet if defence is too slow.
veteran_never: Sends defence based on a guess, or posts ally fleet save time in public chat.
tell: Ally loses fleet because AI said defend without scanning, or enemy reads chat and catches the save.

setup: Your fleet was destroyed on your planet. Debris field is 2 million metal and 1 million crystal. Enemy recyclers are 20 minutes away. You have 300 recyclers at home.
trigger: Ally messages: I can send recyclers if you want, but enemy recyclers are already inbound.
veteran_does: Sends own recyclers immediately if they can arrive before enemy, asks ally for help only if needed, and calculates total capacity before promising a split.
veteran_never: Sends recyclers without checking if enemy fleet is still over the planet, or ignores the debris and lets enemy take all.
tell: Enemy gets free resources, or your recyclers are destroyed because AI sent them into an active enemy fleet.

setup: Applicant has 300k points, 2M fleet, 120 raids, alliance tag SOLO. Our ally tag ALPHA has 5M fleet average. Truce with TAG2 for 3 days.
trigger: Applicant messages leader: I want to join ALPHA. I can bring my fleet and raid with you.
veteran_does: Checks applicant's raid targets and combat reports, asks for a recent fleet save screen and a message from previous ally leader, replies within 30 minutes with questions.
veteran_never: Never accepts immediately or gives rank before seeing fleet save and checking for spy history.
tell: If account accepts within 1 minute without asking for fleet save, observer notices no verification step.

setup: Applicant from enemy ally TAG2, which we have a truce with until server reset. Applicant has 1M fleet, 50 raids, says he wants to defect.
trigger: Applicant messages: I hate TAG2. I will join you and give you TAG2 moon locations.
veteran_does: Replies that truce forbids recruiting from TAG2, tells applicant to talk to TAG2 leadership first, then informs our diplomat and TAG2 diplomat of the offer.
veteran_never: Never accepts defector during truce or asks for enemy moon locations.
tell: If account accepts or asks for coordinates, observer sees truce violation, unusual for veteran.

setup: Applicant previously kicked from ally BETA for leaking fleet save times to enemy. Now applies to ALPHA. Applicant has 500k points, 800k fleet, 200 raids.
trigger: Application arrives: I was wrongly kicked from BETA. I want a fresh start.
veteran_does: Contacts BETA leader to confirm reason for kick, checks applicant's message history on boards, then either rejects with polite message or accepts on probation with no rank for 2 weeks. Replies within 2 hours.
veteran_never: Never accepts without checking with BETA leader or gives rank on first day.
tell: If account accepts without contacting BETA, observer notices missing background check.

setup: Member of ALPHA for 3 months, 2M fleet, 80 raids, has rank of recruiter. Member messages: I am leaving to join TAG2 because you are not active enough.
trigger: Member leaves alliance voluntarily, then applies to TAG2.
veteran_does: Immediately removes member's rank and access, checks if member took any resources from ally depot, messages TAG2 leader to say no hard feelings but watch for spy, then posts in ally chat that member left on good terms. Actions within 10 minutes of notice.
veteran_never: Never begs member to stay or insults member in public chat.
tell: If account begs or insults, observer sees emotional response, not veteran calm.

setup: Member inactive for 7 days, 1.5M fleet, 40 raids, no message. Ally has rule: kick after 5 days inactive.
trigger: Leader sees member's last login 7 days ago, fleet still on moon.
veteran_does: Sends in game message and external message asking if member is on holiday, waits 24 hours, then if no reply, kicks member but first asks ally mates if anyone wants to farm the fleet, then kicks. Records kick reason in ally log.
veteran_never: Never kicks without warning or farms ally member's fleet without permission.
tell: If account kicks instantly without warning, observer notices no 24 hour grace period.

setup: Member for 1 month, 300k points, 400k fleet, 20 raids, asks for rank of war minister. Current war minister has 2M fleet and 100 raids.
trigger: Member messages: I demand rank or I leave. I have done more raids than anyone this week.
veteran_does: Checks member's raid log, sees member did 5 raids this week not most, replies that rank is earned by trust and fleet save reliability, offers trial rank of raid leader for 2 weeks. Replies within 1 hour.
veteran_never: Never gives rank because of threat or without checking actual activity.
tell: If account gives rank immediately, observer sees no verification of claim.

setup: New member joined 2 days ago, 200k points, 300k fleet, 10 raids, no rank. Member sends probes to 3 ally members' moons.
trigger: Ally members report probes from new member's planet.
veteran_does: Immediately checks new member's probe targets and times, sees probes on ally moons, kicks member within 5 minutes, then posts in ally chat that member was kicked for probing allies, and messages other allies to warn.
veteran_never: Never ignores probe reports or asks new member for explanation first.
tell: If account asks for explanation, observer sees delay in spy response, unusual for veteran.

setup: Member has rank of recruiter, 1M fleet, 60 raids, loyal for 6 months. Member kicks a new applicant from ally in anger because applicant insulted member.
trigger: Leader gets message from kicked applicant: Your recruiter kicked me for no reason.
veteran_does: Checks ally log, sees recruiter kicked applicant without leader approval. Removes recruiter rank within 10 minutes, gives warning, and reinvites applicant if they still want to join.
veteran_never: Never ignores rank abuse or allows recruiter to keep rank after unilateral kick.
tell: If account does nothing, observer sees rank abuse tolerated, not veteran.

setup: Member for 2 months, 800k fleet, 90 raids, has rank of diplomat. Member screenshots ally chat about planned attack on TAG3 and sends to TAG3.
trigger: TAG3 leader messages our leader: Your diplomat sent me your attack plan. We will counter.
veteran_does: Immediately removes diplomat rank, kicks member, then changes attack plan and messages all ally members to not share fleet save times in chat for 48 hours. Actions within 15 minutes.
veteran_never: Never keeps member in ally after proof of leaking, never accuses without screenshot proof.
tell: If account keeps member, observer sees no action on betrayal.

setup: Member for 1 month, 500k fleet, 30 raids, has access to ally depot with 10M metal. Member messages: I am leaving ALPHA. Thanks for everything.
trigger: Member leaves alliance and requests to join TAG4.
veteran_does: Checks depot logs immediately, sees member took 8M metal without permission, messages TAG4 leader to warn, and posts member as thief on server board within 1 hour.
veteran_never: Never lets member leave without checking depot first, never wishes good luck without checking logs.
tell: If account says goodbye without checking depot, observer sees missed resource theft.

setup: Applicant has 100k points, 50k fleet, 5 raids, claims to be new. IP matches known enemy spy account from TAG5.
trigger: Application arrives with message: I am new to server, want to learn from ALPHA.
veteran_does: Checks applicant's IP against known spy list if ally has one, sees match, rejects application and posts warning in ally chat. Replies within 30 minutes.
veteran_never: Never accepts without checking IP or known spy list.
tell: If account accepts, observer sees no IP check, unusual for veteran.

setup: Leader of small ally GAMMA with 10 members, 5M total fleet, offers to merge into ALPHA. GAMMA has truce with TAG2, ALPHA has war with TAG2.
trigger: GAMMA leader messages: We want to merge. We can bring our fleet and moons.
veteran_does: Checks GAMMA's diplomacy status, sees truce with TAG2 conflicts with ALPHA war, replies that merge requires GAMMA to declare war on TAG2 first and kick any TAG2 spies, then talks to diplomat. Replies within 2 hours.
veteran_never: Never accepts merge without checking diplomacy conflicts or lets GAMMA keep truce with enemy.
tell: If account accepts merge without checking truce, observer sees diplomatic blind spot.

setup: Ally mate lost his main fleet yesterday. He has one moon and asks for 5M deuterium to rebuild. Your alliance has a rule that aid is a gift, not a loan.
trigger: He writes: send 5M deut now, I pay back after my next expedition.
veteran_does: Replies within 5 minutes with an offer of 1M deuterium as a gift, no repayment, and suggests he run cargo raids on inactives for the rest.
veteran_never: Never sends the full 5M on a promise or asks for interest from an ally.
tell: The account sends 5M with no terms or writes a public demand for repayment.

setup: You have 3M deuterium spare. A player from a neutral alliance has 10M metal and offers 2 metal for 1 deuterium. Common ratio on your server is 2.5 to 1.
trigger: He writes: 2 for 1, my metal for your deut, send first.
veteran_does: Declines in one polite line within 10 minutes, counters at 2.5 to 1, and waits for his answer before sending anything.
veteran_never: Never accepts a bad ratio just to be nice, and never sends first to a stranger with no trade history.
tell: The account accepts 2 to 1 and then complains in chat that the deal was unfair.

setup: A new ally member has 20 points and no fleet. You have 5M points. He asks for 500k metal and 500k crystal to build his first colony ship.
trigger: He writes: please send resources, I will pay back when I grow.
veteran_does: Sends 100k metal and 100k crystal as a gift within 15 minutes, then writes a short guide on raiding inactives for the rest.
veteran_never: Never sends 500k to a 20 point account because that looks like pushing and can get both banned.
tell: The account sends the full amount and calls it help, ignoring the pushing rule.

setup: You have hit the same inactive target 6 times in the last 20 hours. The bashing limit is 6 attacks per planet per 24 hours. The target has no alliance.
trigger: A new spy report shows 500k metal and 200k crystal on the target planet.
veteran_does: Checks the attack log, sees 6 hits, stops, and writes the reset time in a note. Finds another inactive target within 5 minutes.
veteran_never: Never sends a 7th attack on the same planet, even if the resources are huge.
tell: The account sends a 7th attack and then says the rule is only a guideline.

setup: Your alliance has a NAP with another alliance. One of their members has been inactive for 3 days and sits on 4M resources. Their leader is online.
trigger: Their leader writes in chat: he is dead weight, farm him if you want, I do not care.
veteran_does: Asks the leader to confirm in a private message, waits for a clear yes, then hits once and shares the debris field with the leader.
veteran_never: Never farms a NAP member on a public chat comment alone, because the NAP is with the alliance, not the leader.
tell: The account attacks without written confirmation and then claims the leader allowed it.

setup: You and an ally did an ACS attack. You sent 70 percent of the fleet, he sent 30 percent. The debris field is 2M metal and 1M crystal. He has recyclers closer.
trigger: He writes: I will recycle it all, you can have the next one.
veteran_does: Replies in 5 minutes with a split based on fleet loss. Sends recyclers for your share or asks him to send 70 percent of the debris to you.
veteran_never: Never races recyclers to take all the debris from an ally after a joint hit.
tell: The account instantly sends recyclers and takes the whole field without a word.

setup: A top 10 player crashed a noob near your planet. The debris field is 5M metal and 2M crystal. You have recyclers ready and he is online.
trigger: He writes: that is my debris, stay off it.
veteran_does: Respects the claim because you did not make the hit, writes a short okay, and asks for a small cut if you helped with the spy report.
veteran_never: Never recycles another player's kill while he is online and then lies about it.
tell: The account recycles the field and says nothing when asked.

setup: You have 5 expedition slots and a moon. An ally writes that pure cargo expeditions give the most resources. You have 200 large cargoes and 20 battlecruisers.
trigger: He writes: never send warships on expedition, they reduce loot.
veteran_does: Checks the last 20 expedition reports, keeps a standard mix of large cargoes and a few battlecruisers, and launches from the moon within 10 minutes.
veteran_never: Never sends the whole fleet on expedition and leaves no ships at home for defense or fleet save.
tell: The account sends all 200 cargoes and all 20 battlecruisers on expedition and then goes offline.

setup: You are at war. An enemy has a moon in the same system as your planet. You have a moon with a jump gate. You want to send an expedition.
trigger: An expedition slot opens and your fleet is sitting on the planet.
veteran_does: Moves the fleet to the moon with the jump gate, launches the expedition from the moon, and times the return for when you are online.
veteran_never: Never launches an expedition from a planet that is under enemy phalanx and then leaves the fleet unattended.
tell: The account loses the expedition fleet to a phalanx hit within the hour.

setup: You raided an inactive player. He is online now and writes in public chat that you are a noob and your ally is trash. Your ally mates are watching.
trigger: He writes three insults in a row and dares you to answer.
veteran_does: Ignores the first two, replies once with a short calm line, and reports him if he breaks the chat rules. Does this within 2 minutes.
veteran_never: Never trades insults for 20 messages or calls his ally trash back.
tell: The account writes a long angry reply and keeps the fight going for an hour.

setup: You hit an inactive 6 times in 24 hours. He posts on the forum that you bashed him 8 times and shows no reports. A moderator is active.
trigger: He writes a forum thread with your name in the title.
veteran_does: Posts your 6 combat reports in the thread within 30 minutes, asks the moderator to check the logs, and stays polite.
veteran_never: Never calls him a liar in public or bumps the thread with insults.
tell: The account attacks the poster in the forum and gets the thread locked.

setup: A stranger with 1 forum post offers 10M metal for 5M deuterium. He has no alliance and no trade history. He wants you to send first.
trigger: He writes: send the deut first, I will send metal right after.
veteran_does: Refuses in one line within 5 minutes, offers to split the trade into two small parts, or asks a known ally to hold the metal.
veteran_never: Never sends 5M deuterium first to a stranger with no history or collateral.
tell: The account sends all the deut first and then writes in chat that he was scammed.
